scenes.title: E major
scenes.subtitle: Em plus one finger.
lines: This lesson teaches E major — Em plus one finger.
You'll play it cleanly in position, and move to the next chord with control.

scenes.heading: E major (E)
lines: E major is E minor plus one finger.
Keep the Em shape (fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2 of strings 5 and 4) and add finger 1 on string 3 at fret 1.
Strum all six strings — that single note turns a sad, minor sound into a bright, major one.
Let's learn E major — a bright, open chord that's perfect for beginners.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: Em plus finger 1 on string 3. Arch finger 1 so it doesn't touch the open B string next to it.

lines: Let's practice changing between E minor and E major.
Only finger 1 moves — lift it for E major, press it for Em.
Play E major — the app will listen through the microphone and help you sound your best.
